markets.name: freelance-design
markets.description: Freelancers design logos, brands, websites, apps and illustrations, delivered remotely; pay piece by piece, each piece once delivered, so neither side risks much.

markets.name: freelance-software
markets.description: Freelancers build and fix software, delivered remotely; pay piece by piece, each piece once delivered, so neither side risks much.

markets.name: freelance-video
markets.description: Freelancers edit videos and make animations and motion graphics, delivered remotely, not filming at events; pay piece by piece, each piece once delivered, so neither side risks much.

markets.name: goods
markets.description: People sell everyday things, new or used, handed over and paid in person, or shipped when the price is one either side could lose; not motor vehicles or homes.

markets.name: home-cleaning
markets.description: Cleaners clean people's homes, paid by the visit, often every week.

markets.name: home-repair
markets.description: Repairers do plumbing, electrical and handyman jobs in people's homes, each job paid once it is done; not renovations paid in stages.

markets.name: language-exchange
markets.description: Two people practise each other's language, taking turns, online or in person, with no money between them. For adults.

markets.name: sports-coaching
markets.description: Coaches teach a sport or fitness, one on one or in groups, in person or online, paid by the session or the hour; the student is whoever arranges the coaching, often a parent, who stays present for a child's session in person.

markets.name: stays-free
markets.description: Hosts give guests a couch or a room for free, asking only for good company: no tasks and no money between them. For adults.

markets.name: stays-work
markets.description: Hosts give guests a bed, and often meals, for their help, such as on a farm or in a hostel, building, or sitting a house or pets, with no money between them. For adults.

markets.name: tours
markets.description: Local guides show a group around, such as on a food, walking, history or nature tour, paid on the day. For adults.

markets.name: tutoring
markets.description: Tutors teach school subjects, languages, chess and other desk subjects, online or in person, paid by the lesson or the hour; the student is whoever arranges the lessons, often a parent, who stays present for a child's lesson in person.
